submitted.rationale: Across Sb fractions 0.19–0.67, index 2 (Sb 0.27) had the highest measured EQE (0.0076%). EQE was 0.0020% at Sb 0.19 and fell to 0.0046% at 0.36, 0.0005% at 0.50 and 0.0002% at 0.67, so the peak is in the Pb-rich region around Sb 0.25–0.30. The Sb-rich pyrochlore Pb2Sb2O7 and PbSb2O6 compositions perform poorly under 2.1 eV illumination.
